verdict.rationale: The evidence shows tools scoped per app via dedicated per-app MCP servers and the x-pd-app-slug header, and the AI SDK example 'automatically loads all available tools'. Nothing documents meta-tools that let an agent search for and load tools at runtime. Per-app scoping is an adjacent curation control, not the runtime discovery capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
